rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an indoor sports or large entertainment arena.

example.english: The concert is being held in the arena tonight.
example.traditional: 今晚演唱會喺體育館舉行。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 jin2 coeng3 wui2 hai2 tai2 juk6 gun2 geoi2 hang4

rows.note: Use this when emphasizing the venue or facility hosting a sports or spectacular event rather than its arena layout.

example.english: This arena hosts major competitions every year.
example.traditional: 呢個場館每年都會舉辦大型比賽。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 coeng4 gun2 mui5 nin4 dou1 wui5 geoi2 baan6 daai6 jing4 bei2 coi3

rows.note: Use this for an outdoor sports ground or field, especially when the arena is not an enclosed building.

example.english: The kids often play soccer at the arena after school.
example.traditional: 小朋友放學後成日喺運動場踢波。
example.jyutping: siu2 pang4 jau5 fong3 hok6 hau6 sing4 jat6 hai2 wan6 dung6 coeng4 tek3 bo1

rows.note: Use this more formal term when referring specifically to an arena for contests such as bullfighting or other competitive spectacles.

example.english: Bullfights were often held in Spain's arena in the past.
example.traditional: 西班牙嘅競技場以前經常舉行鬥牛。
example.jyutping: sai1 baan1 ngaa4 ge3 ging6 gei6 coeng4 ji5 cin4 ging1 soeng4 geoi2 hang4 dau3 ngau4
